definitions.new_visits: one initial descriptor scan + pair, compaction, and active filter scans per active class per level
definitions.not_priced: 512-byte array initialization, u16 indexing, fields, loads/stores, branches, cycles, allocation, SMT
definitions.old_visits: any predicate prefix including final false scan + two full descriptor loops per level
definitions.point_self_assignment: old compaction with count=1 writes the same stored point to itself; candidate omits it; source-level operation, optimizer may remove it
